name: components/page-layout
description: A minimal page skeleton and composable header primitive. PageLayout provides a full-height flex column with an optional header slot and a scrollable body region. PageLayoutHeader offers four composable slots — leading, content, actions, and trailing — for building consistent page headers without baking in breadcrumb derivation or sidebar logic.
useCases: Dashboard pages with a sidebar trigger in the leading slot, page title in content, and user menu in actions
Settings pages with a back button in leading, breadcrumb trail in content, and save/discard buttons in actions
Detail pages that need a custom header layout using the children escape hatch
Any page that needs a standard header + scrollable body structure without opinionated context resolution
